newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Jan-Sept energy usage up 4.4 percent yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Jan-Sept energy usage up 4.4 percent yr/yr.

text.p: Taiwan's consumption of energy resources in the first nine months of 1996 rose a year-on-year 4.4 percent while supply grew only 2.8 percent, according to government statistics.

Taiwan consumed 53.81 million kilolitre oil equivalents (KLOE) of oil, coal and other sources from January-September and produced 62.01 million, data issued at the weekend by the Directorate General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics showed.
Oil was the top energy resource in the period, contributing 32.90 million KLOE of the production total. Coal contributed 16.90 million KLOE and nuclear 7.0 million.
Imports comprised 95.91 percent of energy resources used in the period, the data showed.
A directorate official reached by telephone attributed the large gap between production and consumption mainly to the burnoff of excess electricity, storage of oil and refining losses.
